subject: Mixed models in R next Friday

messages.author: 4dee24c578d7691c
messages.subject: Mixed models in R next Friday
parts:
Hello R group!,

Next week I will briefly introduce mixed models in R - brief (30 minutes
- really). I will mention the various packages that do mixed models in R
- including ways of estimating confidence intervals for parameters
(often a hiccup for getting significance values for experiments), and
then run through an example with some of my own data (maybe there will
be significant results in here somewhere - wouldn't that be nice?!).
Anyways, the data I will use to demo the models is attached, as well as
a helpful TREE article that goes into detail on various methods from a
fairly R central perspective. The main goal is to clearly explain a
simple example, and then briefly discuss whatever questions / comments
you guys might have.

Cheerio,
Stella

--
Stella Copeland
PhD Candidate
Environmental Science & Policy
UC Davis
